title: JOOR
summary: JOOR is a wholesale management platform and B2B marketplace where brands sell to retail buyers. Connect it to sync your products and wholesale orders, and to push inventory and shipment updates back to JOOR.
body_markdown: JOOR is a wholesale management platform and B2B marketplace where brands sell to retail buyers. Connect it to sync your products and wholesale orders, and to push inventory and shipment updates back to JOOR.
